activeSlice.verification: npm run build passed; npm run typecheck passed; npm run verify:adlib-music-player passed for compiled-browser proof that Mod::loadMusic MUSIC_ADLIB now loads ADLIB.CAT through AdlibMusic, AdlibMusic::play follows the source setup/volume/custom-player route, the translated YM3812UpdateOne mixer produces nonzero samples from real XCOM/SOUND/ADLIB.CAT data, and the old AdlibMusic browser-boundary warning is absent. npm run verify:music-source-priority, npm run verify:startup-browser, and npm run verify:active-mod-runtime passed afterward to protect digital-stream priority, startup audio activation, and active-master resource loading.
